variants.label: A · 银箔窄框
variants.note: 深墨蓝与香槟银，窄边、拉长金属条与不对称角片。
variants.prompt: Use case: isolated transparent game card FRAME asset. Output ONE 1024x1536 portrait 2:3 RGBA image containing ONLY an empty outer ornamental border frame. TRUE alpha transparency BOTH outside the frame and throughout the large central aperture. NO card art, NO illustration, NO characters, NO scene, NO text, NO numbers, NO cost icon, NO title, NO paper-filled reading panel, NO interior dividers. All these are provided by our existing game below the frame and must remain untouched. The supplied image is the existing frame and is a GEOMETRY reference, NOT a card illustration. Preserve its upright full-card outer silhouette and its one continuous tall rectangular transparent opening: approximately x=113 to 912 and y=131 to 1409 on the 1024x1536 canvas. Central content-safe rectangle x=145..880,y=160..1380 must stay 100% transparent; do not add crests extending into this area. No rounded arch across the center, no middle crossbar. Design strictly within the outer border strips and four corners. Full frame visible, no perspective, no background shadow plate. Handcrafted high-end 2D anime game art, sharp controlled edges and selective smooth painted shading. This is a LEGENDARY rarity frame and must feel precious, deliberate and visually distinctive at small size. ART DIRECTION A: refined futuristic silver-foil frame. Long slender matte navy-black side rails layered with brushed champagne-silver strips, four elegantly cut asymmetric corners, one thin short gold accent on the upper right. Broad uninterrupted quiet surfaces, precise sharp silhouette, exceptionally restrained technical jewelry. Minimal fine orbit engraving only on top and bottom border, never crossing the hole. Major material impression is cool premium metal and deep ink. NO scrolls, leaves, paper, gems, ragged tape, neon outlines or huge crests.
